title: Session Investigation
description: Bounded, exact-session drill-down: summary, views/actions, errors, resources, and browser logs for exactly one session_id, entered in the session_id variable below. No session/view listing or overview group-by uses these high-cardinality IDs — they are exact-match drill-down input only. Panels use OpenObserve's own $session_id dashboard-variable substitution, which this stage's backend-only capability audit could not independently verify (docs/openobserve-v0.91-dashboard-capabilities.md capability #13/#13a, since that substitution happens inside OpenObserve's own web UI) — verify visually after install, or edit a panel's query to a literal session_id if it does not behave as expected on your OpenObserve build. No Session Replay panel or replay link is included (Session Replay is Security Blocked — see docs/session-replay-security-decision.md). Installed by pnpm lab:dashboards:install-starters as an initial template — edit or delete freely from the OpenObserve UI; this stage never overwrites your changes.

panels.title: Session summary
panels.description: views/actions/errors/resources counts and session start/end timestamps for this exact session_id.
